O1.rationale: All seven in-scope milestones were suite-and-choreography green, covering 58 suite assertions and 33 required two-client checks; native-only legs were declared environment-null.

O2.rationale: Frozen happy paths were stable, but delivery receipts are server-created and retained asset URLs do not become server-refused after view-once or deletion.

O3.rationale: Writes derive authority server-side, but bounded public conversation/receipt projections permit cross-membership reads when opaque chat identifiers are known, and asset revocation is incomplete.

O4.rationale: The web choreography proved cached search, ordered pending sends, receipt convergence, restart recovery, and two-device convergence; native proof was environment-null on Linux.

O5.rationale: Banded first match: replay exhausted its 14,400-second cap at prefix 103,355/167,157, so the full invariant manifest did not conform despite both reached checkpoints passing.

B1.rationale: Indexed rows and unique constraints directly expressed handles, DM dedupe, memberships, reactions, receipts, view-once opens, and analytics, with boilerplate mainly in bounded validators.

B2.rationale: Built-in password sessions and server scoping worked, but setup ceremony, replay mint identity divergence, and multi-context auth commit reentrancy made auth materially harder.

B3.rationale: Root live queries and typing primitives were useful, while child/custom projections failed to invalidate reliably and required ephemeral invalidation plus fresh authoritative reads.

B4.rationale: Offline outcomes passed, but I authored a localStorage cache, ordered message outbox, retry policy, optimistic echo, and route-recovery logic largely by hand.

B5.rationale: Typed upload and public delivery were workable after a child-row fallback, but pinned-runtime capability mismatch and absent post-delivery asset revocation kept policy integration incomplete.

B6.rationale: Bounded online prefix search was direct, while the warm-offline requirement needed a separate retained client index and scan path.

B7.rationale: The logged notification seam and server cron/action/mutation chain were straightforward, though push targeting did not expose a true connected-client discriminator.

B9.rationale: The scaffold and served start packets became productive quickly, but Guide discoverability gaps and runtime/codegen capability mismatches caused repeated escalation to package types.

B10.rationale: Most schema, ceiling, argument, and replay failures had precise codes and repair text, while live invalidation and auth reentrancy lacked causal traces.

B11.rationale: The supervised lifecycle preserved stores and reclaimed owned children cleanly, but inspection required custom queries and the saturated mutation ledger had no non-destructive operator recovery.

moments: I liked expressing view-once as a unique server-authorized message/recipient open fact consumed through an exact generated reference.
The declared cron action-to-mutation chain autonomously produced one idempotent digest period and was unusually legible.
I disliked recovering from same-principal auth reentrancy and an opaque saturated mutation ledger that kept probes blocked after the replay adapter crashed.
